select t.* from ( select selfy_clothes.id, selfy_clothes.category, selfy_clothes.color, selfy_clothes.currency, selfy_clothes.servertype, selfy_clothes.createtime, c_l.value 'name', c_l.value1 'sort', s_l.value 'source', c_l.language from selfy_clothes inner join EMSelfy_Language as c_l on 1=1 and c_l.restype='selfy_clothes' and c_l.resid=selfy_clothes.id left join Selfy_Source on 1=1 and Selfy_Source.id = c_l.value2 left join EMSelfy_Language as s_l on 1=1 and s_l.restype='selfy_source' and s_l.resid = Selfy_Source.id
where 1=1 <%if(keys){%> <%for(var i in keys){%> <% var key = keys[i].replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/%/g, "%%"); %> and (name like '%<%=key%>%' or selfy_clothes.category like '%<%=key%>%' or selfy_clothes.id = @key) <%}%> <%}%>
<%if(query.category){%> and (selfy_clothes.category = $category) <%}%>
<%if(query.servertype){%> and (selfy_clothes.servertype like @servertype) <%}%>
order by c_l.language desc ) t <%if(query.type == 'favorites'){%> inner join EmSelfy_User_Favorites on EmSelfy_User_Favorites.clothesid = t.id <%}else if(query.type == 'history'){%> inner join EmSelfy_User_History on EmSelfy_User_History.clothesid = t.id <%}%>
group by t.id
